description: This 3D bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different language models across various reasoning types. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy," utilizing a linear scale with values plotted from 0 to at least 0.8, and numeric tick marks evenly spaced at intervals of 0.2. The base of the chart consists of two horizontal axes displaying categorical variables. One horizontal axis lists the models in the order "Davinci-003," "ChatGPT," and "BARD," while the perpendicular horizontal axis lists the reasoning types in the order "Inductive," "Abductive," "Deductive," and "Mix." The chart displays a total of twelve 3D columns arranged in a 3-by-4 grid, with each pillar representing the intersection of a specific model and reasoning category. The columns feature a continuous color gradient mapped to their vertical height, starting from dark blue at the 0 value base and transitioning through cyan and green to yellow at the highest values. The shortest column in the grid corresponds to ChatGPT evaluated on Inductive reasoning, showing an approximate accuracy of 0.15. The tallest column represents Davinci-003 evaluated on Mix reasoning, displaying an approximate accuracy value of 0.75. Intermediate values include BARD on Abductive reasoning at roughly 0.4 and ChatGPT on Mix reasoning at approximately 0.7. The categorical axes do not follow an alphabetical sequence, and the overall bar heights do not exhibit a sorted ascending or descending global order. No specific bars are visually emphasized with distinct annotations, although all columns are drawn with standard black outlines.
